page.overview:
Who is Nyck de Vries?

= Nyck de Vries = Hendrik Johannes Nicasius "Nyck" de Vries (born 6 February 1995) is a Dutch racing driver. He won the 2019 FIA Formula 2 Championship and the 2020–21 Formula E World Championship, becoming the first Dutch driver to do so. De Vries also competed in Formula One for Scuderia AlphaTauri in the 2023 season.{{Infobox Driver

De Vries was born in Uitwellingerga, Netherlands, and began karting at the age of five. He enjoyed success in European karting championships, winning the Karting World Championship in 2010 and 2011. His performances earned him a place in the McLaren Young Driver Programme in 2010.

De Vries entered single-seaters in 2012, competing in the Formula Renault Eurocup. He won the 2014 Eurocup Formula Renault 2.0 championship with Koiranen GP, securing his reputation as a rising star.

In 2015, de Vries raced in Formula Renault 3.5, finishing 3rd overall. He later switched to GP3 with ART Grand Prix in 2016, winning one race and finishing 6th in the standings.
